title: cassia biflora var. rostrata
intro: Cassia biflora var. rostrata, commonly known as the two-flowered acacia, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, characterized by its unique flowers and pods. The two-flowered acacia has been utilized in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and alleviate digestive issues. Therapeutically, it is used as a diuretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a valuable resource in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cassia biflora var. rostrata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
